Container.Name: Vido
Container.Overview: Vido is a NAS media management platform for organizing movies and TV shows with automatic metadata retrieval (TMDb), AI-powered fansub filename parsing, multi-source subtitle search with Traditional Chinese (zh-TW) language detection and OpenCC conversion, and qBittorrent download integration. Built for Taiwanese and Chinese media enthusiasts managing media libraries on NAS devices.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for Vido web interface. The Go API serves both the web UI and API endpoints on this single port.

Config.Name: App Data
Config.Description: Persistent storage for SQLite database, cache, and application data. IMPORTANT: use a direct disk path like /mnt/cache/appdata/vido, NOT /mnt/user/... — the /mnt/user FUSE layer can deadlock SQLite under load (observed in production 2026-08-01).

Config.Name: Backups
Config.Description: Directory for database backups and metadata exports. Same /mnt/cache guidance as App Data.

Config.Name: Media Library
Config.Description: Path to your media library on the host. Mounted read-only. Example: /mnt/user/media

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID the container runs as. Unraid's appdata is owned by nobody:users, which is 99:100 — leave these at 99/100 unless you know you need something else. The container takes ownership of its App Data and Backups folders on start, so changing this is safe and self-healing.

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID the container runs as. See PUID — 100 is Unraid's 'users' group.

Config.Name: TMDb API Key
Config.Description: API key from themoviedb.org for fetching movie and TV show metadata, posters, and images. Get yours at https://www.themoviedb.org/settings/api

Config.Name: TMDb Language
Config.Description: Default language for TMDb metadata. Use ISO 639-1 format: zh-TW (Traditional Chinese), zh-CN (Simplified Chinese), en-US (English).

Config.Name: Gin Mode
Config.Description: Gin framework mode. Use 'release' for production (less logging, better performance) or 'debug' for troubleshooting.

Config.Name: AI Provider
Config.Description: AI provider for filename parsing: 'gemini' (Google) or 'claude' (Anthropic). Requires the corresponding API key below.

Config.Name: Gemini API Key
Config.Description: Google Gemini API key for AI-powered fansub filename parsing. Get yours at https://makersuite.google.com/app/apikey

Config.Name: Claude API Key
Config.Description: Anthropic Claude API key (alternative to Gemini). Also used by the subtitle pipeline's translation leg. Get yours at https://console.anthropic.com/

Config.Name: Subtitle Pipeline Mode
Config.Description: Subtitle backend: 'legacy' = search only (default). 'pipeline' = automatic generation — extract embedded subtitles, fall back to ASR speech recognition, translate to Traditional Chinese.

Config.Name: ASR API Key (OpenAI-compatible)
Config.Description: API key for speech recognition (Whisper-compatible). Works with OpenAI (platform.openai.com), Groq (console.groq.com, free tier), or any OpenAI-compatible ASR server — set ASR Base URL below for non-OpenAI providers. Required for the pipeline's ASR fallback leg. NOTE: read at container start only — changing it requires a container restart.

Config.Name: ASR Base URL
Config.Description: Override the ASR endpoint for OpenAI-compatible providers. Groq: https://api.groq.com/openai/v1 — local faster-whisper server: http://[NAS-IP]:[port]/v1 — leave empty for OpenAI.

Config.Name: ASR Model
Config.Description: ASR model override. Groq: whisper-large-v3 — leave empty for the provider default (OpenAI: whisper-1).

Config.Name: Encryption Key
Config.Description: Exactly 32 characters (AES-256) for the in-app secrets store — required for the settings page to SAVE API keys (without it the page is read-only: writable=false / encryption_key_missing). Generate with: openssl rand -base64 24. KEEP IT STABLE — changing it makes previously saved keys undecryptable.

Config.Name: Login Password
Config.Description: Single shared password that gates the WHOLE app (login required). STRONGLY recommended before sharing this instance or exposing it beyond a trusted LAN. Leave EMPTY to keep the old no-login behaviour (only safe on a private home network / behind a VPN). Without it, anyone who can reach the server has full control: read/change settings and API keys, download the database backup, add torrents.
